input.summary: 221 workforce roles mapped across 9 C-suite owners; 89% source-backed, zero active assignments confirmed.
sources: Meridian Health System planning-grade synthetic context — PHI-free

story.meaning: Meridian's C-suite is broadly aligned on five AI-era priorities, but no role carries a confirmed active ownership assignment — every initiative sits in candidate status.
story.observed: 221 workforce role-to-use-case mappings are catalogued at 89% confidence; 158 are high-confidence, 63 medium. Zero rows are marked active. CEO, CFO, CIO, CTO, and CDAO each sponsor multiple overlapping use cases with no single accountable owner per initiative.
story.matters: Overlapping sponsorship without confirmed ownership means evidence-closure decisions have no clear decision-maker. Governance gaps — no formal operating model, no AI audit trail — will persist until role accountability is locked.
story.supports: Assigning confirmed owners per use case is the prerequisite gate before any of the five priority initiatives can advance from planning to decision grade in Nexus.

findings: Zero of 221 mapped workforce roles carry an active ownership status — every initiative remains in candidate limbo, blocking evidence-closure decisions across all five priority use cases.
CEO, CFO, and CIO each co-sponsor call center optimization, cost transparency, and AI governance with no designated decision-maker, creating accountability diffusion at the highest level.

CISO and Chief Experience Officer hold single-use-case sponsorships (AI Governance and Member Service Agent Assist) — narrow mandates that are under-resourced relative to cross-cutting evidence gaps they must resolve.
63 medium-confidence role mappings are concentrated in CEO and CFO portfolios, signaling that the highest-stakes initiatives carry the weakest ownership evidence and require immediate validation.

chain: Workforce role ownership → Evidence-closure authority → Use-case advancement gate
CEO/CFO/CIO co-sponsorship overlap → Accountability diffusion → No single decision-maker per initiative
CDAO ownership → Data governance operating model → AI audit trail → All seven use cases unblocked
CTO ownership → AWS/Databricks foundation readiness → Lakehouse and AI/LLM use cases unblocked
CISO ownership → AI model risk controls → FY26 AI spend governance gate cleared
relationships.note: Every downstream use-case evidence gate — medallion architecture, semantic layer, transcript governance, provider contract digitization — requires a confirmed workforce owner to authorize closure. Until active assignments are locked, Nexus cannot advance any initiative from planning to decision grade.

evidence.name: Workforce Roles Dataset
evidence.facts: 158 high-confidence mappings, 63 medium-confidence; 89% overall source-backed confidence; 216 evidence references loaded
evidence.fields: Role title, sponsoring function, use-case alignment, confidence tier, active/candidate status, evidence ID
evidence.supports: Confirms breadth of C-suite alignment across five priority use cases; exposes zero active ownership as the critical workforce gap
evidence.missing: Active ownership designations; validated medium-confidence mappings; cross-functional RACI; platform readiness owner

evidence.name: CEO / Enterprise Strategy Role Mappings
evidence.facts: CEO sponsors unified lakehouse, AI/LLM governance, call center optimization, provider quality, cost transparency, payment integrity, and automated close — the broadest portfolio of any single role
evidence.supports: Establishes CEO as the highest-breadth sponsor; medium-confidence on lakehouse and cost transparency signals validation urgency
evidence.missing: Confirmed active ownership designation; validated evidence for lakehouse medallion architecture and cost allocation rules

evidence.name: CFO / Finance & Value Role Mappings
evidence.facts: CFO co-sponsors all CEO use cases plus AI Benefits Realization Ledger; certified finance semantic layer and close workflow integration are unresolved blockers within CFO's own portfolio
evidence.supports: CFO's AI Benefits Realization Ledger is unique to this role and requires FP&A validation and usage extracts not yet evidenced
evidence.missing: Certified finance semantic layer; close workflow integration evidence; FP&A validation extracts

evidence.name: CIO / CTO / CDAO Role Mappings
evidence.rows: 17 combined use-case mappings (16 high, 1 medium confidence)
evidence.facts: CIO owns FY26 AI spend governance uniquely; CTO holds all high-confidence mappings but no platform readiness owner is named; CDAO owns the three use cases most dependent on unresolved governance gaps
evidence.fields: Role, use-case name, confidence, evidence_needed, evidence_id
evidence.supports: Technology and data leadership roles are the highest-confidence cluster but face the deepest structural evidence gaps — platform foundation, governance model, and semantic layer all unresolved
evidence.missing: Named AWS/Databricks platform owner; CDAO governance charter; certified semantic layer ownership

evidence.name: CISO / Chief Experience Officer Role Mappings
evidence.facts: CISO owns AI Governance / Model Risk Controls; Chief Experience Officer owns Member Service Agent Assist Transformation; both require HITL, audit logging, and approved business case evidence not yet loaded
evidence.fields: Role, use-case name, confidence, evidence_needed, evidence_id
evidence.supports: Narrow mandates are high-confidence but under-resourced; both roles depend on cross-functional evidence gaps (AI audit trail, transcript governance) they do not own
evidence.missing: HITL and audit logging evidence; approved business case; AHT/FCR/CSAT baselines; cross-functional RACI linkage

evidence.name: Contact Center / Member Service Operations Role Mapping
evidence.facts: Contact Center Operations sponsors Contact Center Platform / Knowledge Modernization; AHT, FCR, transfer rate, CSAT, and QA baselines are all required and not yet evidenced
evidence.fields: Role, use-case name, confidence, evidence_needed, evidence_id
evidence.supports: Operational role with direct accountability for call center optimization outcomes; baseline metrics absence is the single gate blocking use-case advancement
evidence.missing: AHT, FCR, transfer rate, CSAT, and QA baseline data; transcript governance evidence; real-time CRM integration proof
